# varco version

Print build version.

## Usage

```text
varco version [options]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-json` | `bool` | `false` | print version as JSON |

The help output leaves out a default that equals the zero value of the flag type; the table above shows that zero value.

## Exit codes

See [exit codes](../exit-codes.md) for the process exit codes varco returns.
